INGREDIENTS

  • 85g / 3 ounces organic baby spinach
  • 709 / 2 large oranges, peeled and quartered
  • 365g / 2 medium bananas
  • 121g / 1 cup raspberries
  • ½ cup crushed ice
  • 79ml / ⅓ cup mango juice concentrate

PREPARATION

  1. Place all ingredients in a large blender or a food processor fitted with a steel blade. Process until smooth.
  2. Serve in a glass. Drink. Go be awesome.
